sloka: निवृत्तिश्चागता सौम्य सन्तापश्च निराकृतः ।भवद्वाक्यैः सुरुचिरैरनुनीतो ऽस्मि लक्ष्मण ।। ७.५२.१९ ।।
transliteration: nivṛttiścāgatā saumya santāpaśca nirākṛtaḥ ।bhavadvākyaiḥ surucirairanunīto 'smi lakṣmaṇa ।। 7.52.19 ।।

translations.english: O gentle Lakshmana, relief has come, and my sorrow has been dispelled; I have been comforted by your very pleasing words. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे द्विपञ्चाशः सर्गः ।। 52 ।। Thus ends the fifty-second sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
